title: DAVE classroom file
description: A teacher's rules for DAVE's guard: base rules for every lesson, plus lessons students switch between with /guard lesson. A student's guard.jsonc turns it on with "classroom".

rules.markdownDescription: Same rules as guard.jsonc. Add `"note"` to explain a question or block in your own words.

dial.markdownDescription: Decides calls no rule matched. Leave out to let the student's own settings decide.

policy.markdownDescription: Plain sentences added to the judge's policy, such as `The student may not ask DAVE to write graded answers.`

class.description: The class name, shown to students and in the audit file.

version.description: Your label for this version of the file, such as a date. The audit file records it.

base.description: Rules, dial and judge policy that apply in every lesson.

lessons.description: Lessons by name. Students switch with /guard lesson <name>.

title.description: What the lesson is about, shown by /guard lesson.

tools.markdownDescription: The only tools DAVE has in this lesson, MCP tools included; `*` works: `["read", "grep", "find", "ls"]`. Leave out to keep all of them.
